_meta.note: Constants that are NOT in the game's defines.lua: found by fitting the 80 fixture saves, then recorded here with their evidence. calc.py reads them through game_data.const() like any define; change only with a new research result and a verified stage.
_meta.FIXED_POINT_SCALE: the game computes and stores values in 3-decimal fixed point with truncation: val 83,201/83,201, power_fraction 42,323/42,330, share_total 42,330/42,330 (README integration log)
_meta.TRANSFER_FRACTION: docs/research/R04 + project check: t_out = trunc3(0.5 * (val - 0.1)) in 1,855/1,855 entries
_meta.TRANSFER_MIN_POWER_KEPT: same check: val - 2 * t_out is between 0.100 and 0.101 for every giver; origin of the 0.1 unexplained

TRANSFER_FRACTION.comment: share of (val - TRANSFER_MIN_POWER_KEPT) a subject transfers to its overlord

TRANSFER_MIN_POWER_KEPT.comment: subtracted from val before the transfer fraction is applied
